title: A deterministic tree with bounded average cost
statement: Let the input alphabet be finite. For every randomized decision tree and every probability distribution on the input alphabet, there is a seed whose selected deterministic tree has average query cost at most the randomized tree’s average query cost.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution on the input alphabet
